fields.subject: SQL Server Connection Settings
fields.where: the host has registered SQL Server services, binding the SqlGlobalSettings configuration section to SqlGlobalPropertiesOptions
fields.trigger: the SqlDatabases or SqlShardSets collection is constructed
fields.response: supply the bound SqlGlobalPropertiesOptions value (a SqlConnectionPropertiesBase that adds no members of its own) as the global level of the Configuration hierarchy for every database and shard-set endpoint in that collection
fields.postcondition: a SqlClient setting given once under SqlGlobalSettings applies to every SQL Server connection unless a database, shard-set, read/write, shard or endpoint level overrides it
